data.name: Usage
data.value: Usage: helix-cache lookup submission.json --cache DIRECTORY --output lookup.json [--queue-info queues.json] helix-cache store execution.json --results DIRECTORY --cache DIRECTORY Only Linux x64 queues and digest-pinned container references are supported.

data.name: UnsupportedPlatform
data.value: This prototype requires a Linux host.

data.name: Queue
data.value: Queue '{0}' is missing, unavailable, or not a Linux AMD64 queue.

data.name: Container
data.value: Container reference '{0}' must end in an explicit @sha256: digest.

data.name: Payload
data.value: Payload '{0}' must be a directory or a ZIP archive.

data.name: Symlink
data.value: Symbolic links are not supported in directory payloads or results: {0}. Use an archive for payloads containing links.

data.name: NestedCache
data.value: Cache or staging directory '{0}' must not be inside input directory '{1}'.

data.name: Corrupt
data.value: Cache entry or snapshot failed validation: {0}.

data.name: Result
data.value: Results are incomplete, unsuccessful, or do not match the execution record: {0}.

data.name: Report
data.value: Expected a completed, nonempty, passing xUnit report: {0}.

data.name: RelativePath
data.value: Expected a relative path without traversal: {0}.
